author: Ari Koslow
title: Munetaka Murakami (hamstring) close to starting rehab assignment
desc: The White Sox say Munetaka Murakami is close to starting a rehab assignment.
impact: Murakami was able to take batting practice on the field on Thursday. He'll still need to run the bases before he is cleared to go on a rehab assignment.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Dylan Cease dominates Mariners for fifth win Friday
desc: Blue Jays right-hander Dylan Cease pitched seven shutout innings while striking out nine to earn the win over the Mariners on Friday.
impact: Cease was purely dominant in this one, yielding just three hits and one walk to go along with nine strikeouts while notching his fifth win of the season. He threw 70 of his 102 pitches for strikes on the evening while facing just three batters over the minimum in his seven innings of work. The star right-hander has been as advertised in his first season with the Blue Jays, posting a 2.79 ERA and a massive 137:41 K:BB across 16 starts and 90 1/3 innings of work. He lines up to take on the Giants in a favorable road start in San Francisco on Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mike Trout (hamstring) aiming to return from IL next week
desc: Mike Trout told reporters Friday that he's aiming to return from the injured list next week.
impact: Trout went through his normal pregame routine on Friday. He could make his return without requiring a rehab assignment. He has been on the IL recovering from a hamstring strain.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Evan Sisk (elbow) placed on IL
desc: The Pirates placed LHP Evan Sisk on the 15-day injured list with left elbow inflammation.
impact: Sisk had been pitching well to the tune of a 2.23 ERA in the bullpen for Pittsburgh. He is without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hunter Stratton recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Pirates recalled RHP Hunter Stratton from Triple-A Indianapolis.
impact: Stratton will hold a middle-relief role in the bullpen for Pittsburgh.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bailey Ober (elbow) to make rehab start Saturday
desc: Bailey Ober will make a rehab start for Triple-A St. Paul on Saturday.
impact: Ober allowed three runs over 3 1/3 innings for High-A Cedar Rapids last Sunday in his first rehab outing. He is working his way back from a mild flexor strain.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Louis Varland nails down save Friday versus Mariners
desc: Blue Jays right-hander Louis Varland pitched a scoreless ninth inning to earn the save in a 2-0 win over the Mariners on Friday.
impact: Varland allowed a one-out single to Dominic Canzone, but struck out Cal Raleigh before incuding a game-ending force out of Josh Naylor to end the contest. Varland continues to shine as one of the best relievers in all of baseball this season, as he is now a clean 18-for-18 in save opportunities to go along with a sterling 0.96 ERA, an identical 0.96 WHIP, and a 65:13 K:BB across 47 innings of work.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brendan Beck recalled by Yankees
desc: The Yankees recalled RHP Brendan Beck from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre.
impact: Beck is set to start Saturday and take the rotation spot of Carlos Rodon. He made his MLB debut back in May out of the bullpen. He is purely a player to monitor for now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Young scratched with hand injury Saturday
desc: Jacob Young was scratched from the lineup for Saturday's game against the Pirates with left hand soreness.
impact: It appears to be a precautionary move. Young is day-to-day heading into Sunday.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Brady Singer hit with loss versus Orioles Friday
desc: Reds right-hander Brady Singer allowed three runs (two earned) across five innings while taking the loss on Friday against the Orioles.
impact: Singer wasn't terrible in this one after getting roughed up in his previous start, but he did allow five walks to go along with three hits surrendered and six strikeouts on the night. Unfortunately, he would have had to been nearly perfect to avoid the loss in this one as the Reds mustered just four hits - albeit with six walks - while being shut out in a 3-0 final score. The loss dropped the veteran to 3-8 on the season with a 5.03 ERA through 17 starts. He will either take on the Phillies at home on Thursday or the Cubs at home on Friday, depending on if the club deploys a six-man rotation after the return of ace Hunter Greene on Saturday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Byron Buxton (hip) returns to lineup Saturday
desc: Byron Buxton is back in the Twins lineup on Saturday against the Yankees.
impact: Buxton makes his return from a four-game absence. He is back in center field and batting second.

author: Ari Koslow
title: LaMonte Wade Jr. (hamstring) to be activated from IL
desc: The Astros are activating LaMonte Wade Jr. from the injured list on Saturday.
impact: Wade has been on the injured list since June 9 with right hamstring soreness. He began a rehab assignment earlier this week. There is no word yet on the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zach Dezenzo to be called up from Triple-A
desc: The Astros are reportedly calling Zach Dezenzo up from Triple-A Sugar Land.
impact: Dezenzo will return to the majors after being optioned back in early June. There is no word yet on the corresponding move.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Elly De La Cruz swipes pair of bases in loss to Orioles Friday
desc: Reds shortstop Elly De La Cruz went 1-for-3 with two walks and two stolen bases in a 3-0 loss to the Orioles on Friday.
impact: De La Cruz walked in the first inning, walked again and stole second in the third, and singled and stole second base in the fifth. However, the Reds' mustered just four total hits on the evening and were unable to get the speedster home despite reaching as far as third base in this one. The star shortstop is now up to 12 steals on the season to go along with a .273/.343/.483 slash line with 13 homers, 44 runs, and 40 RBI across an injury-shortened 68 games played.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Christian Scott allows two homers in first loss
desc: Christian Scott took his first loss of the season Friday against Atlanta after allowing three runs on two hits and four walks over four innings. He struck out seven and generated 13 swinging strikes on 82 pitches, but both hits he surrendered were home runs.
impact: Scott has allowed six homers over his last three outings despite recording 19 strikeouts across 13 innings during that stretch. He owns a 3.49 ERA, 1.35 WHIP, and 60:25 K over 49 innings and is lined up to face the Royals at home next week.
